integrity: The source integrator and its energy factor are attributed to Wu and Shu (2026). The new algebraic positivity boundary is accompanied by an exact polynomial sign proof and a standalone checker. Numerical diagnostics are not substituted for a global proof; historical priority remains qualified.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive coefficients, one unweighted three-vertex path, linear autonomous diffusion, source-specific order-two symmetric filtering, and completed-step positivity within the unconditional energy-stable coefficient regime only. No universal classification for arbitrary graphs, variable coefficients, nonlinear operators, or internal stages.
title: A sharp positivity–energy gap for second-order two-sided filtered Heun on a three-site diffusion path
